notes: 150 Craftsman's Writ items (264011-264045 Journeyman... by id range: 264011-264055 journeyman, 264056-264115 expert, 264116-264160 artisan). Writ names/ids come from items.json; tier/rep from id range + guide (75/125/200). Recipe data from Wowhead classic (reagents, skill, trainer/recipe source). Classic recipes assumed unchanged in Forever except where noted. Vendor reagent prices come from Wowhead sold-by lists (min price, unlimited-stock vendor preferred); they may reflect Forever pricing; vendor:false means no vendor listed. No enchanting, cooking or first aid writs exist. Writ-to-item mapping of "Mithril Spurs" and "Soul Pouch" are only listed in the conquestcapped guide. skillRequired is the Wowhead classic recipe requirement; writGuideSkill (where present) is the number printed by conquestcapped, which often differs (guide values appear to be skill-up/yellow thresholds, not requirement) - verify in game.
